newsitem.title: USA: U.S. BULK MILLFEEDS-PRICES STEADY IN SLOW ACTIVITY.
newsitem.headline: U.S. BULK MILLFEEDS-PRICES STEADY IN SLOW ACTIVITY.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were mostly steady on Monday in featureless markets, dealers said.
There was no feature in the Buffalo market, "just the continued lack of (flour mill) runtime which seems to be keeping things fairly firm," a Buffalo dealer said.
In Minneapolis, spot prices were unchanged, bid at $57 a ton and offered at $63 a ton.
"This is a typical summer pattern. We got the rain, we got the pastures," a Minneapolis dealer said.
The dealer was referring to adequate pasture land in the upper Midwest. "The recent rain in Wisconsin and Minnesota has kept everything lush and green," he said.
Light weekend showers also fell in parts of Illinois and Indiana but more rain is forecast, Weather Services Corp said.
"But once we get into the fall, then you would expect a pickup in demand," the Minneapolis dealer said.
